items.title: Open-sourced solution to AI manage Playwright automations
items.raw_excerpt: We built a comprehensive system that connects directly to the AI agents through MCP for writing, managing most type of browser automations. Purpose is for automated testing or automating browser based workflows. It provides notifications, scheduling, pre/post hooks, IAM management, cookies support, json payloads. Has a hybrid Chrome extension too, that can agents can read to write automations directly instead of you writing the the prompt. From developer of Sorify - on Apache 2.0
